title: T-Dex
provider: Guzey et al. 2023 (CoRL, New York University)
about: Teleoperated Allegro hand on a Kinova Jaco arm with 15 XELA uSkin 4×4 three-axis pads, recorded as task-agnostic play plus demonstrations of five contact-rich tasks: 38 play recordings and 32 task demonstrations in the release.

hardware.v: Allegro (16 DoF, 4 fingers) + 15 XELA uSkin pads
hardware.d: 4 pads per finger, 3 on the thumb · 4×4 taxels, (x, y, z) each, uncalibrated · ~98.5 Hz in the files (paper: 100 Hz)
Joint states and end-effector pose at 50 Hz; Allegro joint states and PD efforts at ~300 Hz
1280×720 · ~30 fps · one static camera in play, two in task demonstrations

hardware.v: Holo-Dex (Oculus headset hand pose) + Kinova joystick
hardware.d: Folder name gives the task; no object, scene or operator labels

notes: Paper: arXiv 2303.12076 (CoRL 2023). No license or terms of use were found for the data (project page, GitHub README and repository, Drive folder); the arXiv licence covers only the paper. The release is two zips on a public Google Drive folder; each sampled recording is read from them by byte range. Camera videos are the release's AVIs re-timed by their frame timestamps, re-encoded to H.264 and re-hosted. All tactile pads are shown in the release's own pad layout (one column per finger), with per-pad (x, y, z) sums as arrows; which Allegro finger each of columns 1-3 is, and which slot is the fingertip, is not documented. The Allegro PD efforts and Kinova joint efforts are plotted.
